next.reason: 1985: 'When the MESSAGE phrase is used, end of segment indicators are ignored, and the following rules apply to the data transfer'; 2023: 'RECEIVE now gets a message from a server/requestor run unit; no MESSAGE phrase, queues, or segment/group indicators remain'.
